text: You just chugged a whole soda way too fast, and now your body keeps jumping.
Right under your lungs sits a big dome of muscle called your diaphragm.
Every time you breathe in, it pulls down nice and smooth.
But all that fizz stretches your stomach and pushes up on it.
That bugs the nerves that run your diaphragm, and they misfire.
So it yanks down hard, all at once, and sucks in air.
A split second later, your vocal cords slam shut.
The air smacks into them, and that's the hic you hear.
Most hiccups stop in a few minutes, but one man hiccuped for sixty-eight years.
That's about four hundred thirty million hics.
If yours last more than two days, go see a doctor.
Subscribe, because that's what really causes hiccups.
